lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgV2O5 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 32-atom unit cell containing Mg4V8O20 and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers in tetrahedral O coordination (4 neighbors, 1.89–1.94 Å) and V centers in octahedral O coordination (6 neighbors, 2.00–2.19 Å). Corner-sharing is observed between Mg tetrahedra and V octahedra, and between V octahedra, while O-centered octahedra display corner-, edge-, and face-sharing. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
